svg.title: DKD-centered study framework
svg.desc: Hybrid SVG of DKD-centered study framework, panels a–f. High-resolution transparent raster organ illustrations are embedded in six reusable symbols. All scientific text and values are preserved. Text, charts, arrows, panel frames and other shapes remain editable vectors, with consistent typography and aligned layout.
